info.description:
A free, public, read-only REST API exposing The Holistic Care's open mindfulness resources — research citations (whitepapers), a plain-language glossary, free mindfulness games, free guided-audio practices, blog post excerpts, The Holistic Care Podcast episodes (English and Hindi), and the public PanchaVikas early-years framework — as structured JSON. No authentication required. A unified `/v1/resources` browse endpoint and a `/v1/search` endpoint aggregate across every family at once. Blog endpoints expose metadata/excerpts only — full article content remains on the canonical The Holistic Care website. See `/docs` for a fair-use/attribution note and a versioning policy alongside this reference.
